      public boolean canTransferToBudget()
      Checks whether a paid student can transfer to a budget.

    • canGetHonorsDiploma

      public boolean canGetHonorsDiploma()
      Checks the honors diploma criteria using the latest numeric grade per discipline.
      Returns:
      true if at least 75% of those grades are excellent, none are satisfactory, and the thesis grade is either excellent or still pending

    • canGetIncreasedScholarship

      public boolean canGetIncreasedScholarship()
      Checks the scholarship criterion using grades from the first unfinished semester.

      true if that semester has at least one numeric grade and all its numeric grades are excellent
